title: HtmlFooter
responsibility: Renders the native footer element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlFooter.attributes
inputs.description: Native footer attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlFooter.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native footer element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlFooter
outputs.description: The actual native footer element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
